products.title: Head Revolt Court 5.0 Men Black White - Head
products.description:
HEAD REVOLT COURT 5.0 MEN BLACK WHITE - Head's mid-range shoe, a model that highlights versatility for everyday use on the slopes. 

The HEAD REVOLT COURT 5.0 MEN BLACK WHITE are very versatile mid-range sneakers, comfortable and with personality under a classic design in black and white details, an aesthetic with which you will never go wrong.

This model is committed to lightness and comfort from the first use. The soft mesh upper wraps the foot with a flexible and breathable feel, while strategically placed PU reinforcements protect the areas that suffer the most on the court.

In the lower area, the cushioned EVA midsole absorbs impacts effectively and maintains a balanced footprint. The PU insole adds extra softness that is appreciated during prolonged training. It is not an exaggerated cushioning, but rather comfortable and stable, designed for those who play regularly but without professional demands.

What type of player are they recommended for?

For occasional players, committed beginners or athletes who train with moderate frequency and are looking for a comfortable, light shoe with a modern design.

products.title: Nox Start Blue Ex Js 2026 - Nox
products.description:
NOX START BLUE EX JS 2026 - A perfect racket to start playing on the right foot. It shares construction with the Black version, but completely changes its aesthetics with a blue finish that gives it a fresher and sportier look. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The NOX START BLUE EX JS 2026 is the perfect racket to start with. Round control racket, with a lot of control, for defensive players looking to improve and not miss a ball. This 2026 season, it is one of the star rackets of the low-medium range.

PLAYER TYPE

For beginner-advanced-intermediate level players. We especially like it to continue gaining experience on the track. It is a shovel that makes things much easier for you.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

As its main characteristics, we have to highlight its peculiar round format. It is a round shape that provides low balance and has a wide sweet spot, as well as a perforation that is different from the rest, but that gives very good results.

It is a fiberglass racket and has an Eva HR3 Soft core, which is a total success for players who suffer from elbow discomfort and want a soft-touch racket.

products.title: Softee Summit 3.0 Yellow Power - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE SUMMIT 3.0 YELLOW POWER - A complete padel racket with which you will notice the quality in each stroke. Made entirely of carbon fiber. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

SOFTEE SUMMIT 3.0 YELLOW POWER, the most complete Summit range racket in yellow, for the player who wants a more striking and cheerful aesthetic. This padel racket has a hybrid-teardrop format which guarantees total balance for all types of players.

PLAYER TYPE

Due to the characteristics it presents, this racket is aimed at players of all levels because it is a very easy racket to handle but due to materials and so on, it is aimed at an advanced player looking for a good response on all shots.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

This is one of the Softee rackets from the 2023 collection. This model has a hybrid format, which generates a central balance, to be able to move the racket comfortably without noticing excess weight in the tip or in the fist.

This racket is made up of 100% carbon fiber, which on the court translates into a dry hit, and with more power. Inside we find S9 soft eva rubber.

PLAY STYLE

On the court the SOFTEE SUMMIT 3.0 YELLOW POWER is a high quality racket, focused on balanced play.

products.title: 750ml Softee Gym Blue Bottle - Accessories
products.description:
750ML SOFTEE GYM BLUE BOTTLE - A practical and comfortable bottle to take to the gym or to your padel training sessions. The 750ML SOFTEE GYM BLUE BOTTLE is a very practical and functional accessory for our matches, padel training or to take to the gym comfortably.

It has a non-slip area, which improves grip even when hands are wet or sweaty, preventing the bottle from slipping during use. In addition, it incorporates an ergonomic lid with a practical spout, which makes it easy to drink comfortably without having to unscrew it.

With a capacity of 750 ml, it offers the perfect size to maintain good hydration during physical activity.

products.title: Special Pack Enebe Mustang 12k Blue 2025 - Enebe
products.description:
SPECIAL PACK ENEBE MUSTANG 12K BLUE 2025 - This model of the Enebe racket is the brand's best-seller, a very balanced and complete 12K carbon racket. The Enebe Mustang 12K Blue has become one of the brand's best-selling padel rackets. Its 12K carbon construction and balanced behavior make it a very complete option for players looking to perform well in any game situation.

To complete this pack you will receive a practical racket bag to carry all your equipment, 10 overgrips to renew your grip when necessary, 1 protector to help keep the racket in better condition and 1 can of balls so you can use it for the first time.

products.title: Drawer 24 Bottles Dunlop Fort Padel - Dunlop
products.description:
DRAWER OF 24 DUNLOP FORT PADEL JARS - Dunlop's new high-end balls. High performance, high durability, this new DUNLOP FORT PADEL 24 BOTTLE DRAWER offers you everything that a demanding player looks for in a padel ball. It is a ball approved by the International Paddle Federation.

This box consists of 24 cans of 3 balls per can, making a total of 72 balls per box. Ideal for clubs or players who play very regularly.
